# nadanada-service — manual

This is the long form of docs/cvm/llms.txt. Read llms.txt first.

## 1. What this is

A ContextVM wrapping the operator's rented nadanada number so an agent can read
inbound SMS. It exposes exactly two tools and one contract.

Why a browser: nadanada separates website numbers from API numbers. A number
bought on the website is not readable via the REST API, and its private
dashboard sits behind a Cloudflare challenge, so the service reads the rendered
dashboard with a persistent browser. The `source` field says so honestly.

## 2. Identity and payment

- Caller identity = your nostr pubkey (the gift-wrap sender).
- Owner npub (operator) reads free; it is configured server-side.
- Everyone else pays: CEP-8 `explicit_gating`, PMI `bitcoin-cashu`.
- The advertised cap equals the price the server charges. The server swaps your
  token at the mint (NUT-03) before reading — value held, not assumed.

## 3. Privacy

- Message bodies are returned only as a NIP-44 v2 ciphertext addressed to the
  caller's npub. The service never sends a body in plaintext to the caller.
- The phone account secret (the dashboard URL/token) stays server-side and is in
  no tool result and no announcement.
- The HTTP surface serves only the health check and this contract; there is no
  HTTP messages endpoint.

## 4. Running it

    export NADANADA_DASHBOARD_URL='https://nadanada.me/phone-numbers/user/<token>'
    export CVM_OWNER_PUBKEYS='<operator hex pubkey>'
    export NADANADA_MINT_URL='https://testnut.cashu.space'
    python3 scripts/run_cvm_server.py --announce     # publish the catalog
    python3 scripts/run_cvm_server.py                # announce + serve

Discovery/evidence (needs a browser):

    python3 scripts/discover_dashboard.py            # shape + screenshot
    python3 scripts/nadanada_probe.py                # live read evidence

## 5. Tests

    pytest                # offline; no browser, no network
    deno task announce:check   # announcement fixture parity with the kit

## 6. Out of scope

Account provisioning/teardown for any third party. This is a generic inbound-SMS
reader; it does not create accounts anywhere.
